mapper.select: WITH LineCount AS ( SELECT ol.CompanyId AS CompanyId, ol.OrderId AS OrderId, COUNT(*) AS Lines FROM {{schema}}.ShopOrderLines AS ol GROUP BY ol.CompanyId, ol.OrderId) SELECT o.CompanyId AS CompanyId, o.OrderId AS OrderId, lc.Lines AS Lines FROM {{schema}}.ShopOrders AS o JOIN LineCount AS lc ON lc.CompanyId = o.CompanyId AND lc.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE lc.Lines >= (SELECT MAX(m.Lines) FROM LineCount AS m)
